item.title: I-76 West to shut down overnight for months near 30th Street due to Market Street Bridge construction

item.title: Atlantic City Mayor Marty Small trial for alleged child abuse begins: Opening statements
item.description: Opening statements have begun in the trial of Atlantic City Mayor Marty Small, who is accused of abusing his teenage daughter. Trial begins for Atlantic City mayor Mayor Marty Small is facing charges of second-degree child endangerment, witness tampering, aggravated assault, and making terroristic threats. Among the alleged abuse, the mayor is accused of beating his then-16-year-old daughter unconscious with a broom, punching her repeatedly in the legs and attempting to influence her testimony.

item.title: Philadelphia braces for coldest air of the season: Temps to plummet Tuesday
item.description: Philadelphia is gearing up for a frigid start to the day as temperatures are set to plummet overnight.
